**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471` on the gateway. It set connection-per-request but left pool size at 20. Impact ran `02:14:14Z` to log end `03:59`, 530 503s, 83% error rate, still failing. Roll back `dep-4471`.

Two notes in there. Paging lagged the first 503 by 67 minutes. And worker job time triples across the window with flat `db_wait`, unrelated, needs its own ticket.
